items.sectionTitle: GLDO Overview
items.text: Goal-line dropout (GLDO) outcomes depend on (1) who put the ball in-goal and how, (2) who makes the ball dead and how, and (3) restart options described in Law 12 (Kick-off & Restart Kicks) and in-goal outcomes described in Law 21. The scenarios below capture common permutations for 15s Rugby Union.

items.sectionTitle: Abbreviations
items.text: 5m Scrum = attacking feed; 22m DO = 22-metre drop-out; DBL = dead-ball line; FOP = field-of-play; GLDO = goal-line drop-out; HW = half-way line; TIG = touch-in-goal.

items.sectionTitle: Restart Options (1–3)
items.text: Option 1: 22m DO or scrum from where ball was kicked (see Law 12). Option 2: Kick retaken or scrum back at centre of restart line (see Law 12). Option 3: If without delay, kick retaken or scrum at centre of restart line; if delayed and made dead in-goal, GLDO (see Law 12, Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 1 — Attack carry; Attack make dead TIG/DBL from in-goal
items.text: Outcome: 22m DO by defence (see Law 12; made dead in-goal).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 2 — Attack carry; Attack knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: GLDO by defence (see Law 12 & Law 21; attack knock-on in-goal).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 3 — Attack carry; Defence knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attacking team (see Law 21; defence knock-on in-goal).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 4 — Attack kick in open play; Attack make dead TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: 22m DO by defence (see Law 12; ball kicked then made dead in-goal by attack).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 5 — Attack kick in open play; Attack knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: GLDO by defence (see Law 12 & Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 6 — Attack kick in open play; Defence knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attacking team (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 7 — Attack goal attempt (PK/DG); Attack make dead TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: 22m DO by defence (see Law 12; unsuccessful goal made dead in-goal by attack).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 8 — Attack goal attempt (PK/DG); Attack knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: GLDO by defence (see Law 12 & Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 9 — Attack goal attempt (PK/DG); Defence knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attacking team (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 10 — Attack restart (HW/22/GL); Attack make dead TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: 22m DO by defence (see Law 12).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 11 — Attack restart; Attack knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: GLDO by defence (see Law 12 & Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 12 — Attack restart; Defence knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attacking team (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 13 — Attack charge-down; Attack make dead TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: 22m DO by defence (see Law 12).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 14 — Attack charge-down; Attack knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: GLDO by defence (see Law 12 & Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 15 — Attack charge-down; Defence knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attacking team (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 16 — Defence carry; Attack make dead TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attacking team (see Law 21; defence took ball in-goal, attack made dead).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 17 — Defence carry; Attack knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: GLDO by defence (see Law 12 & Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 18 — Defence carry; Defence knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attacking team (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 19 — Defence kick/knock back; Attack make dead TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attacking team (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 20 — Defence kick/knock back; Attack knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: GLDO by defence (see Law 12 & Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 21 — Defence kick/knock back; Defence knock forward in-goal
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attacking team (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 22 — Any team; Ball continues TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: GLDO (see Law 12; ball runs into TIG/DBL).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 23 — Any team; Held up in-goal
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum (see Law 21; held up).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 24 — Attack kick (FK/PK not for goal); Ball continues TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: GLDO (see Law 12).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 25 — Attack kick (FK/PK not for goal); Held up
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 26 — Goal attempt (PK/DG); Ball continues TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: GLDO (see Law 12; unsuccessful attempt made dead beyond goal line).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 27 — Goal attempt (PK/DG); Held up
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 28 — Restart (HW/22/GL); Ball continues TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: GLDO (see Law 12).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 29 — Restart (HW/22/GL); Held up
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 30 — Charge-down; Ball continues TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: GLDO (see Law 12).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 31 — Charge-down; Held up
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 32 — Defence carry; Ball continues TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attackers (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 33 — Defence carry; Held up
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 34 — Defence kick/knock back; Ball continues TIG/DBL
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum to attackers (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 35 — Defence kick/knock back; Held up
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum (see Law 21).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 36 — Restart; Options 3 apply
items.text: Outcome: GLDO if delay; otherwise kick retaken or scrum at centre of restart line (see Law 12).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 37 — Charge-down; 22m DO (if applicable)
items.text: Outcome: GLDO per scenario notes; some situations produce 22m DO (see Law 12).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 38 — Restart; Options 2 apply
items.text: Outcome: Kick retaken or scrum back at centre of restart line (see Law 12).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 39 — Restart; 22m DO (if applicable)
items.text: Outcome: GLDO or 22m DO depending on restart/sanction line details (see Law 12).

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 40 — Defence carry; 5m scrum
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum (attacking feed) — in-goal grounding/touch outcomes per Law 21.

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 41 — Defence kick/knock back; 5m scrum
items.text: Outcome: 5m scrum (attacking feed) — ball becomes dead in-goal per Law 21.

items.sectionTitle: Scenario 42 — Restart; GLDO
items.text: Outcome: GLDO (see Law 12; restart situations where ball is made dead in-goal).

items.sectionTitle: Other GLDO Scenarios & Edge Cases
items.text: Try if attackers ground legally (Law 21). Mark by defence in-goal → FK in line with mark, 5m out (Law 20/21 local policy). Deliberate knock into TIG/DBL → PK (Law 9 foul play + Law 21 outcome). Attack knock forward from FOP into in-goal → scrum to defence (≥5m) (Law 21). Restart kick crosses sanction line and blown back into own in-goal and made dead → 5m scrum to opponents (Law 12/21). Ball or ball carrier touches referee/non-player in-goal → see Law 6.11/6.12. Doubt over first grounder → 5m scrum, attacking feed (Law 21). Simultaneous ground + TIG/DBL → 22m DO (Law 12/21).
